calls.title: Forecast Meeting
calls.summary: The team discussed launching targeted executive dinners in San Francisco to deepen customer relationships and test the format for future expansion, with the goal of inviting 10 customers per event. The strategy includes a mix of 50% existing clients and 50% prospects to optimize relationship building, with follow-up cities like New York and London under consideration. The sales pipeline aims for $1 million in new expansion revenue, potentially raising annual recurring revenue to $14 million. Current pipeline commitments total over $225k, with a conservative target of $350k. Significant customer engagements have been identified, including Hims for product adoption and strategic relationships with Square and Khan Academy. Competitive dynamics focus on engaging diverse stakeholders for winning deals and addressing data visibility challenges in tracking sales.
